translate the input/output, so you can roleplay without knowing model's language.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLorebook\u003c/strong\u003e: Also known as world infos or memory book, which can make character memorize more.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eThemes\u003c/strong\u003e: Choose it from 3 themes, Classic, WaifuLike, WaifuCut.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePowerful Prompting\u003c/strong\u003e: Change the prompting order easily, Impersonate inside prompts, Use conditions, variables... and friendly\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTTS\u003c/strong\u003e: Use TTS to make the output text into voice.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAdditional <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Multiple API Supports</strong>: Supports OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepInfra, Ooba, OpenRouter... and More!</li>
<li><strong>Emotion Images</strong>: Display the image of the current character, according to his/her expressions!</li>
<li><strong>Group Chats</strong>: Multiple characters in one chat.</li>
<li><strong>Plugins</strong>: Add your features and providers, and simply share.</li>
<li><strong>Regex Script</strong>: Modify model's output by regex, to make a custom GUI and others</li>
<li><strong>Powerful Translators</strong>: Automatically translate the input/output, so you can roleplay without knowing model's language.</li>
<li><strong>Lorebook</strong>: Also known as world infos or memory book, which can make character memorize more.</li>
<li><strong>Themes</strong>: Choose it from 3 themes, Classic, WaifuLike, WaifuCut.</li>
<li><strong>Powerful Prompting</strong>: Change the prompting order easily, Impersonate inside prompts, Use conditions, variables... and more!</li>
<li><strong>Customizable, Friendly UI</strong>: Great Accessibility and mobile friendly</li>
<li><strong>TTS</strong>: Use TTS to make the output text into voice.</li>
<li><strong>Additional Assets</strong>: Embed your images, audios and videos to bot, and make it display at chat or background!</li>
<li><strong>Long-term Memory</strong>: Advanced memory systems including HypaMemoryV2/V3 memory compression, SupaMemory for context management to maintain long-term conversation context.</li>
<li>And More!</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">You can get detailed information on <a href="https://github.com/kwaroran/Risuai/wiki">https://github.com/kwaroran/Risuai/wiki</a> (Work in Progress)</p>
